purpose: Prospective corrected native single-compartment voltage-calcium-SK confirmation after v1 was technically invalidated by unplanned automatic calcium reversal recomputation.
calcium_reversal_policy: After all mechanism insertions, force ca_ion concentrations to STATE and eca to a fixed PARAMETER via ion_style(c_style=3,e_style=1,einit=0,eadvance=0,cinit=0); assign eca=120mV after finitialize; measure and assert eca remains fixed at every step.
negative_control: Compare coupled calcium with a frozen-cai analytic arm and report calcium, SK and voltage contrasts for each non-rest episode. Report updated-gate source timing diagnostically, never use it to select the candidate or adjust thresholds.
decision: First require native eca fixed to 120mV at every step, all native trajectories finite, and the exact-formula/native 40ms confirmation floor below unchanged v1 thresholds. If that floor fails, no learned-model verdict. If it passes, judge every frozen both-arm family/seed on confirmation voltage, calcium, SK and physical bounds. 80ms and frozen-cai contrast are diagnostic. V1 remains technically invalid and is not retroactively promoted. No model retraining or outcome-driven threshold changes.
scope: One compartment, original eleven channel NMODL mechanisms plus CaDynamics_E2, autonomous voltage and cai, exogenous current, fixed eca/ena/ek, no morphology, synapses, stochasticity or speed claim. Frozen neural rates for five channels; six canonical formula channels, analytic CaDynamics and SK current.
